methodology.notes: Agent: Apollo-1 (AUI), using Apollo runtime-v2 at commit e32b98d37, program tau-v30 (planning on, planner_reasoning high, effort tier high). User simulator: gpt-6-luna, temperature 1.0, reasoning effort: API default (not set), tau2's default user-simulator prompt. Seed 300, 50 tasks x 4 trials, every first attempt scored (no reruns). Average agent cost per conversation comes from the run's model ledger, using $0.10/M input, $0.01/M cached input, and $0.50/M output tokens for Luna model calls and $0.042/M input tokens for Jev.

verification.details: Custom agent framework (Apollo runtime-v2 governed kernel) with its own agent prompts, tool layer and policy program; tau2's user simulator prompt, tasks, policy text and evaluator are unmodified. The user simulator's only model argument is temperature 1.0 (gpt-6-luna refuses tau2's default 0.0); no reasoning_effort is sent. The trajectory field info.agent_info.llm records the harness default gpt-4.1-2025-04-14. The methodology notes describe the models Apollo used.
